concern_summary: This concern involves generating localized messages related to the reimbursement process, indicating the status of reimbursements such as whether they are queued or canceled, along with relevant details like the submitter's display name and the amount.
This concern deals with report actions related to messages, updating their resolutions and managing state changes to capture actions like payment requests and authentication completions.

This concern encapsulates the functionalities related to displaying messages associated with bank account validation and management, including error notifications and user guidance during the process of linking or managing bank accounts.
This concern focuses on displaying and managing various types of user messages, including system notifications and money request messages with associated transaction details.
This concern centers around messages related to IOU transactions, generating user-friendly notifications regarding amounts submitted and report submissions.
This concern involves managing transaction messages, including statuses and descriptions, ensuring accurate information is displayed regarding financial transactions and their states.
This concern addresses the management and retrieval of messages associated with report actions, including checking for attachments and drafting messages for report submissions.
This concern revolves around onboarding messages, including the management of errors during onboarding and communication of violations or necessary introductory messages to users.
This concern involves the navigation aspects related to links, focusing on how links are handled and displayed in the context of reports and user selections within the application.
